table3_1_validity.title: Table 3.1 Cluster validity of the selected partition (c* = 2) against 1,000 permutation nulls
table3_1_validity.note: One-sided permutation p-values. The selection-aware row compares the best value over c = 2–8 with the best value attained on each null dataset. The null selected c* = 2 in 86% of replicates.

table3_2_replication.title: Table 3.2 Stability and replication of the subgroups
table3_2_replication.note: Stability: 200 subsamples of 80% of the participants. Replication: means [2.5th, 97.5th percentiles] over 50 splits into halves A and B, subgroups formed on A; ε² = H/(n − 1) of Kruskal–Wallis tests; profile correlation: correlation over the models between each subgroup's deviations from the mean scores in A and in B, weighted by subgroup size. Reliability: null mean [95% range].

table3_3_baselines.title: Table 3.3 Algorithm 1 and other clustering methods, each against its own permutation null
table3_3_baselines.note: Euclidean silhouettes on the same P-HFE profiles; 100 null replicates per method. All methods except HDBSCAN and Louvain use c = 2. Modularity of the Louvain communities on the current relation: 0.096 (null mean 0.097, p = 0.733). Published SCO-FCM: the baseline's initial centers and reachability matrix (the background and current relations combined with ζ) with its soft-constrained objective, under either direction of the consensus cost, or with its Algorithm 3, which adds the cost to the distance; with the inverse cost, Algorithm 3 also placed all participants in one subgroup.

table3_4_external.title: Table 3.4 Sociodemographic validation of the subgroups
table3_4_external.note: Attributes were not used for clustering. Cramér's V: association with subgroup membership; R²: share of the variation in preference profiles explained by the attribute (PERMANOVA). 999 permutations each.

tableS1_sensitivity.title: Table S1 Sensitivity to the balancing parameters and robustness checks (supplementary)
tableS1_sensitivity.note: Each configuration was compared with the same 1,000 permutation nulls as Table 3.1; the graded encoding with 200.

tableS2_representation.title: Table S2 Representation of sociodemographic groups by the pooled and the SCO-FCM consensus rankings (supplementary)
tableS2_representation.note: Kendall's τ between a group's model ranking and the ranking named in the column; p tests whether the group is represented worse than a random group of the same size (999 permutations).
